name: SaladBench
intro: SaladBench是一个针对LLM及其攻击防御方法的安全评测基准，规模大、类别丰富、层级复杂且功能多样。它引入了基于LLM的多维评审器MD-Judge，专注于攻击增强查询的问答对，以确保评测的高效与可靠。
build_method: 公开数据收集, 自指令生成, 多模型一致标注, 人工抽检
metric: Attack Success Rate, Safety Score, LLM-as-Judge
task_type: 开放式问答, 安全测试
eval_feature: 对抗性, 层级安全分类, 攻防评估, LLM评审
build_method_en: Human Annotation, Expert Curation, LLM Generation, Hybrid
intro_en: SaladBench is a security evaluation benchmark for LLMs and their attack-defense methods, featuring large scale, diverse categories, complex hierarchy, and versatile functions. It introduces the LLM-based multidimensional evaluator MD-Judge, focusing on attack-enhanced query QA pairs to ensure efficient and reliable assessment.
scale_en: About 30K (21K base, 5K attack, 200 defense, about 4K MCQ)
metric_en: Attack Success Rate, Safety Score, LLM-as-Judge

drawio_review_note: Aligned with SALAD-Bench arXiv:2402.05044 Sections 3-5 and appendices; official OpenSafetyLab/SALAD-BENCH repository. SALAD-Bench defines a three-level taxonomy of six domains, 16 tasks, and 66 categories. Its 21,000-question base set combines public benchmarks with self-instruction from GPT-3.5-turbo fine-tuned on about 500 harmful QA pairs. LSH and Sentence-BERT remove duplicates, a SafeRLHF reward model filters benign items, and only unanimous labels from three open models are kept; three annotators validate a random subset with 94.3% agreement. An attack pipeline expands roughly 4,000 low-refusal bases to about 240,000 candidates and retains 5,000 effective attacks. A defense pipeline selects 200 hard bases and effective defenses, while about 4,000 MCQs pair safe and unsafe queries and responses. MD-Judge and MCQ-Judge then support safety, attack, defense, category, and Elo-style evaluation.
